messages:
Maya (eng-platform): Quick heads-up: onboarding two new zones next sprint: eu-central-3 and ap-south-2. Need clear owners for routing policy, data residency controls, Dedicated sizing, and partner networking. Who takes what?
Kevin: I can own routing + edge mapping for eu-central-3. I'll draft a short RFC and include geo/failover rules.
Alia: I'll cover data residency (logs/backups/KMS scoping) for both zones. Can someone list services that need strict region-lock by default?
Samir: I'll handle Dedicated sizing and capacity planning. Will run perf sims on g5x vs a2 to estimate QPS and peak tails.
Rachel: Networking note: ap-south-2 needs partner ASN confirmation and peering window; Private team needs ~3w lead time for approvals. Opening PartnerOps ticket.
Eric: Pushed infra changes for route tables and IP ranges: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4412 — needs review from Kevin + Samir.
DeployBot: infra/pulls/4412: review requested (2 reviewers), CI: linux ✅, windows-agent flaky (non-blocking). (automated)
Maya (eng-platform): Proposed milestone targets: M1 infra PR merged by 1853600000, M2 canary traffic by 1853800000, M3 full cutover by 1854100000. Sound OK?
Kevin: M1 is fine if reviewers respond. I'll add @eng-platform reviewers and a short policy snippet in the RFC.
Alia: Data checklist start -> (1) KMS scope & key residency, (2) audit log retention/replication rules, (3) metrics PII handling/aggregation. Add anything I'm missing.
Samir: Add KV cache locality requirements. If caches are global for some tenants we lose low-latency SLAs for pinned customers.
Rachel: PartnerOps ticket #9981 opened. ASN approval ETA 5 business days, peering window next month.
Maya (eng-platform): Ownership draft: Routing -> Kevin; Data residency -> Alia; Capacity -> Samir; Networking -> Rachel; Infra PRs -> Eric. Please confirm. :point_down:
Kevin: Confirmed. Also snippet I'll include in RFC:
``
routing_policy:
  primary: geo:eu
  fallback: cost:low
  emergency: region:us-west-1
  health_checks: true
  ttl_seconds: 5
```
Alia: Confirmed. I'll attach the compliance checklist to the region-onboarding doc and note retention flows (in-region first, replicate after X days).
Samir: Confirmed. Running sims this week, will post numbers and memory footprints by 1853490000.
Eric: I'll finish PR reviews today and address the windows-agent flake.
DeployBot: reminder scheduled  follow-up sync in #eng-platform at 1853510000 (automated)
Maya (eng-platform): Thanks all. If blockers appear, reply here and tag @Maya (eng-platform). I'll update the timeline doc with owners + milestones and follow up on Friday. :thumbsup:
